# August 2025 (version 1.104) _Release date: September 11, 2025_ **Update 1.104.1**: The update addresses these [issues](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A%22August+2025+Recovery+1%22+). **Update 1.104.2**: The update addresses these [issues](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A%22August+2025+Recovery+2%22+). **Update 1.104.3**: The update addresses these [issues](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A%22August+2025+Recovery+3%22+). --- Welcome to the August 2025 release of Visual Studio Code.
